escenas.texto: This week in Oceania, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over one hundred and forty-four million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Oceania edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Oceania. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, measured this Sunday. Let's go.
Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. Next up, number ten, from Australia, Ken, with “what”. Over seven hundred and forty-nine thousand views. It also has over one thousand comments.

Next up, number nine, from New Zealand, Dolan Darkest, with “How Are These People Real”. Over eight hundred and twenty-four thousand views. It got there in just one day. It also has over two thousand comments.

Number eight, from Australia, Stimpee, with “The New DayZ Badlands DLC is Brutal”. Over eight hundred and forty-seven thousand views. It got there in just one day. It also has nine hundred and ninety comments.

Coming in at number seven, from Australia, DarkViperAU, with “PS3 GTA 5 Was NOT What I Expected - Part 1”. Over nine hundred and ninety-eight thousand views. A video over sixty-three minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has eight hundred and twenty-three comments.

Number six, from New Zealand, Viva La Dirt League, with “Ridiculous skill trees in PoE2”. Over one point two million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: three out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over two thousand comments.

Number five, from Australia, EYstreem, with “I Survived 100 Days as VERITY in Minecraft”. Over one point two million views. A video over twenty-eight minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has six hundred and sixty-four comments.
At number four, from Australia, Phoenix SC, with “Mojang, what in the actual heck? LOL.”. Over one point four million views. It also has over two thousand comments.

Bronze medal, BigKCinema, with “Miles just doesn't care about villains anymore”. Over twelve million views. And get this: it's a channel with about sixteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just eight seconds.

Silver medal, from Australia, Melto, with “Every Home Has A Monster Alarm”. Over twelve million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and forty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just forty-nine seconds.

And here it is. Number one most viewed, Merry Latte, with “Comment STRAW if you NEED this!”. Over thirty-six million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about two hundred and twenty thousand views per hour. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-four thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. In position number ten, from Australia, Bub Games, with “trolling serious military roleplayers in gta...”. Over one thousand comments. It got there in just one day. It also has over three hundred and sixty thousand views.
Coming in at number nine, from Australia, Ken, with “what”. Over one thousand comments. It also has over seven hundred and forty-nine thousand views.

Coming in at number eight, Slushy Noobz, with “We weren't ready for this game...”. Over one thousand comments. A video over fifty-eight minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over five hundred and thirty-five thousand views.
Number seven, from Australia, TGG, with a video posted five days ago. Over one thousand comments. It also has over six hundred and fifty-four thousand views.

Next up, number six, from Australia, Skill Up, with a video posted three days ago. Over one thousand comments. A video over thirty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over three hundred and seventy-eight thousand views.

Number five, Dejahvoe Ivoe, with “Mass Effect: Universe Trailer”. Over two thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about one thousand, nine hundred subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over three hundred and eighty-six thousand views.

Coming in at number four, from New Zealand, Dolan Darkest, with “How Are These People Real”. Over two thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about thirty-six thousand views per hour. It got there in just one day.
Bronze medal, from Australia, Phoenix SC, with “Mojang, what in the actual heck? LOL.”. Over two thousand comments. It also has over one point four million views.
Silver medal, from New Zealand, Viva La Dirt League, with “Ridiculous skill trees in PoE2”. Over two thousand comments. It also has over one point two million views.

And finally, number one most commented, from Australia, Dantics, with a video posted three days ago. Over five thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: six out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over three hundred and ninety-eight thousand views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. In position number ten, from Australia, TGG, with a video posted five days ago. Over sixteen thousand likes. It also has over six hundred and fifty-four thousand views.

Number nine, from Australia, DarkViperAU, with “PS3 GTA 5 Was NOT What I Expected - Part 1”. Over sixteen thousand likes. A video over sixty-three minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over nine hundred and ninety-eight thousand views.

At number eight, from Australia, Dantics, with a video posted three days ago. Over seventeen thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: six out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over three hundred and ninety-eight thousand views.

Next up, number seven, from Australia, Stimpee, with “The New DayZ Badlands DLC is Brutal”. Over twenty-one thousand likes. It got there in just one day. It also has over eight hundred and forty-seven thousand views.
In position number six, from Australia, Ken, with “what”. Over twenty-two thousand likes. It also has over seven hundred and forty-nine thousand views.
Coming in at number five, from Australia, Phoenix SC, with “Mojang, what in the actual heck? LOL.”. Over thirty thousand likes. It also has over one point four million views.
Number four, from New Zealand, Viva La Dirt League, with “Ridiculous skill trees in PoE2”. Over thirty-seven thousand likes. It also has over one point two million views.

Bronze medal, BigKCinema, with “Miles just doesn't care about villains anymore”. Over two hundred and eighteen thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about sixteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just eight seconds.

Silver medal, from Australia, Melto, with “Every Home Has A Monster Alarm”. Over two hundred and thirty-four thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and forty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just forty-nine seconds.

And finally, number one most liked, Merry Latte, with “Comment STRAW if you NEED this!”. Over two hundred and fifty-eight thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about two hundred and twenty thousand views per hour. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-four thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Asia. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown?
